stem: Based on a random sample of 700 people living in a certain area, a confidence interval for the proportion, $p$, of all people living in that area who had travelled abroad was found to be $0.5672 < p < 0.6528$.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the proportion of people in the sample who had travelled abroad.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Find the confidence level of this confidence interval. Give your answer correct to the nearest integer.
